comment: Every source below answered when this file was generated.
'sources' is a preference list: the app tries each in order at play time
and uses the first that actually responds, so a broadcaster's own stream
going down falls through to their official YouTube feed automatically.
type 'hls_api'    : url returns JSON; 'jsonField' names the manifest field.
type 'hls_scrape' : url is a web page; 'pattern' is a regex matching the manifest.
type 'youtube'    : 'youtubeChannelId' is asked for the CURRENT live video at
play time, so the entry survives a stream restart.
type 'youtube_playlist' : url is a YouTube playlist id from the rights
holder's own channel; opening it lists the episodes.
Drop an edited copy at /data/data/com.arslan.tv/files/channels.json to change
